THE RED AND THE BLACK
This episode will begin with a short recap of its prequel in §
which Mulder professes his great doubts about the existence of
extraterrestrial life, and moreover his disbelief in Cassandra
Spender: the so-called Patient X, a noted alien abductee. While
in Russia, then again in rural Virginia, large groups of people
have been summoned by some unknown force, only to be incinerated
by strange faceless men who land in glowing UFOs.
We find ourselves ultimately with a large congregation of
"abductees" atop a dam, over which flies just such a craft,
which upon landing emits faceless "pirates" who begin
murderously lighting congregants on fire. One of whom is Scully.
